doc.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25

title: Tony Jackson and Tommy Ladnier, whom she did not know
summary: She does not recall pianist Tony Jackson or Tommy Ladnier.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: What about Tony Jackson? Did you ever know him around Chicago or here?
He was a piano player. Tony Jackson. He wrote Pretty Baby. Yeah.
No, I, I, I, I don't remember Tony Jackson. I can't remember him. He didn't play in any of the leading bands around there.
Well, I think he was mostly, uh, just a piano player.
A soloist player to himself. No, I don't, uh, remember him because most of the bands around Chicago, I mostly knew of, you know, by way. You know, by working around there. Because, uh,
What about, uh, Tommy Ladinier? Did you ever know him in Chicago?
He was from down here. In Mandeville. I thought maybe you knew him.
